decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component spraying system fits WIWA's core spray-technology direction and is still shown on the website, so management attributes any slow uptake to the market ramp-up and keeps investing.

The firm has made a visible public commitment through a dedicated page and a reported field test going back to 2021, so its sunk investment and the need to justify the decision strongly favor keeping the product.
The low-pressure pump line is announced as a new range built on the proven WIWA air motors, which makes it central to the announced direction and cheap to keep alongside Product B.
Fire protection flow monitoring sits further from the core spraying business, but it is presented on its own page, and that visible commitment and investment lead management to persist with it.
Launched only in 2024 and closely aligned with the hydraulic two-component core business, the product is too new to judge, so any weak early results are treated as temporary.
